crossRefs.note: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
crossRefs.keyword: It cannot be gotten for gold. Heb. Fine gold shall not begiven for it

crossRefs.note: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

crossRefs.note: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
